description: This PHP script manages plugin creation and grouping for Revive Adserver, including functions for file operations, plugin and group setup, and handling form submissions.

methods.name: putPlugin
methods.description: Creates plugin XML and readme files based on provided plugin values.

methods.name: putGroup
methods.description: Creates group XML files for plugins based on group values.

methods.name: _putFile
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in source file content with values and writes to target.

methods.name: _makeDir
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: _fileMissing
methods.description: Checks if a file does not exist.
